purpose: Baseline capture for the 30-day SLO observation period start (2026-10-26 UTC). All numbers below come from live measurements on AKS cluster aks-portfolio-dev; none are estimated.

prometheus_mock_query_api.used_for: opsbridge-api server-side counters (http_requests_received_total) and latency histogram (http_request_duration_seconds_*)
prometheus_mock_query_api.note: prometheus-mock scrapes opsbridge-api.flashsale:80. It is NOT kube-prometheus-stack; no CronJob was deployed.

in_cluster_probe_job.method: batch Job sli-probe-baseline (ns default, image curlimages/curl:8.11.1), 30 sequential GETs per endpoint, curl -w time_total
in_cluster_probe_job.used_for: external-probe availability + latency for opsbridge-api (/healthz), bankops-api (/api/v1/health/live, /api/v1/health/ready)

data_sources.keda_metrics_api: Not used for baseline HTTP SLIs; available via keda-operator-metrics-apiserver for autoscaling-driven SLIs later.

sli_definitions_applied.availability: 1 - (5xx_count / total_requests). Codes 2xx+3xx count as success (docs/slo.md, deploy/sli/availability.md). Source docs use status buckets 2xx/4xx on opsbridge-api middleware.
sli_definitions_applied.latency_p95: 95th percentile of request latency. Target p95 < 500ms (deploy/sli/latency_p95.md). Histogram buckets present in mock: le in {0.001..32.768}; nearest bucket to 500ms is 0.512s.

prometheus_mock_server_side.window: 40m (full TSDB history of the mock at capture time)
prometheus_mock_server_side.note: 4xx are 6 POST /api/v1/outbox/requeue unauthorized attempts from the alert-drill; not 5xx.

prometheus_mock_server_side.reason: prometheus-mock scrape config has no quanlykho job (only opsbridge, prometheus, drill-target).

sre-demo-api.status: NOT DEPLOYED on cluster aks-portfolio-dev; scripts/measure_sli_30day.py (which queries sre_api_requests_total) cannot run against this cluster.

proposed_thresholds_from_docs_slo_md.status: PROPOSED — not binding until 30-day observation completes and stakeholders sign off

baseline_vs_proposed.availability: PASS on captured sample (100% on all three probes; mock shows 0 5xx over 40m)
baseline_vs_proposed.latency_p95: PASS on captured sample (54.55ms opsbridge / 15.21ms bankops worst case, far under 500ms)
baseline_vs_proposed.throughput: NOT MEASURED — baseline sample is health-endpoint traffic; opsbridge server-side rate 0.32 RPS; 100 RPS test requires load generator and is out of scope for this capture

known_findings.finding: ClusterIP service access to bankops-api.quanlykho.svc.cluster.local:8000 times out from a pod in ns default (curl code 000 after ~135s), while direct pod IP 10.224.0.22:8000 returns 200 in ~4.5ms and kubectl port-forward works. No NetworkPolicy exists in quanlykho (kubectl get netpol -n quanlykho = empty). Likely kube-proxy/service-segment quirk on AKS; re-test before relying on cross-namespace ClusterIP access.
known_findings.impact: Daily SLI probe for bankops-api used pod IP directly (recorded above); pod IP must be re-resolved each run.

known_findings.finding: prometheus-mock does not expose the metric names required by scripts/measure_sli_30day.py (sre_api_requests_total for sre-demo-api). Observation runs use the mock's own counter/histogram names for opsbridge and direct probes for bankops.
known_findings.impact: Daily capture cannot reuse the repo script as-is; runbook below uses direct Prom queries.
